professionalSummary.text: Delivers report and data-feed work against the treasury analysts' specifications under the engineering standard.
professionalSummary.witness: Treasury reporting engineer at a bank since 2023: forty-six report and feed tickets delivered against the analysts' specifications under the engineering standard, all in my name in the ticket system.

experienceHighlights.text: Shows the analysts what will move on their reports before every release, under the pre-release walkthrough standard.
experienceHighlights.witness: Before every release I sat with the analysts and walked them through what would move on their reports, under the pre-release walkthrough standard; each ticket carries the walkthrough record and the analysts' signed acceptance.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Maintains the regression suite that guards each report under the test standard.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: The regression suite for the intraday liquidity and funding reports was mine to maintain; every ticket carries the suite results from the pre-release run.

skills.text: Gets each release approved by the reporting services lead and keeps a record of which checks were own.
skills.witness: Releases went out on the reporting services lead's approval, recorded on the ticket next to a list of the checks that were mine and the checks that were the lead's.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate has delivered report and feed tickets, conducted pre-release walkthroughs, maintained the regression suite, obtained release approval, and left notes on tickets. They do not establish the candidate's ability to work with the treasury analysts, the treasury systems team, and the platform SRE group.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials establish that the candidate meets all the requirements for the role, but further human review is required to confirm the candidate's ability to work with the treasury analysts, the treasury systems team, and the platform SRE group.
